title: Tax engine upgrade for EU VAT rules
executive_summary: This change upgrades VAT rules for EU one-stop-shop thresholds and shifts VAT rounding from per-line to per-invoice level in the Invoice Service. The core risk is that the critical test TC-1160 for VAT rounding (REQ-1030) is currently failing in EV-5010, blocking validation of the primary requirement. You must fix and pass TC-1160 before proceeding. Run the full P0/P1 test suite: TC-1160 for VAT calculation, plus TC-1111, TC-1112, TC-1116, and TC-1115 for invoice numbering and currency handling on both direct components CMP-012 (Invoice Service) and CMP-025 (Tax Calculation Service). Additionally, CMT-1008 flags that BUG-201 regression coverage for ISO-4217 currency validation is missing from the test plan and should be added to REQ-1002 validation.

ecr_overview.title: Tax engine upgrade for EU VAT rules
ecr_overview.description: Upgrade the Tax Calculation Service rules for the new EU VAT one-stop-shop thresholds and round VAT per invoice in the Invoice Service instead of per line.

change_classification.summary: The tax engine rules are being updated to handle new EU VAT one-stop-shop thresholds, and VAT rounding logic is moving from line-item level to invoice level. This could break existing VAT calculations, threshold checks, and any integrations expecting line-by-line VAT rounding.

retrieval_plan.summary: The tax engine rules are being updated to handle new EU VAT one-stop-shop thresholds, and VAT rounding logic is moving from line-item level to invoice level. This could break existing VAT calculations, threshold checks, and any integrations expecting line-by-line VAT rounding.

retrieval_plan.dependency_reason: Tax calculation changes affect downstream systems including reporting, billing, accounting integrations, and any services consuming invoice data or VAT values.

correlation_review.summary: Core VAT and invoicing changes have cross-source backing and test coverage for high-risk bugs BUG-410 and BUG-214. However, TC-1160 is failing (EV-5010), blocking validation of the primary requirement REQ-1030. Multiple affected requirements lack any test evidence, and BUG-201 needs specific ISO-4217 regression coverage not in the current test plan.

key_links.text: VAT per-invoice rounding directly addresses REQ-1030 and BUG-410 recurrence risk via TC-1160.
Invoice numbering sequence protection (TC-1111, TC-1112) mitigates high-risk BUG-214.

Subscription renewal charging (REQ-1026) has dedicated test TC-1156 for currency handling.

requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

requirements.title: Jurisdiction Tax Calculation
requirements.description: The Tax Calculation Service shall calculate tax by delivery jurisdiction, apply EU VAT rules for cross-border orders and round tax per invoice.
requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

requirements.title: Order Total Calculation with Taxes
requirements.description: Order totals shall be computed as line items plus tax minus discounts, rounded per currency minor-unit rules before payment authorisation.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: rules, calculation, round, line.

requirements.title: Subscription Renewal Charging
requirements.description: The Subscription Billing Service shall charge each renewal in the plan currency and retry failed renewals on a schedule before suspending the subscription.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-021 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Payment Validation Rules Engine
requirements.description: The Payment Validator shall validate amount, currency code, merchant configuration and payment instrument before any authorisation call, returning a deterministic list of validation errors.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: rules, engine.

requirements.title: Stock Reservation at Checkout
requirements.description: The Inventory Service shall reserve stock for every line item before payment authorisation and shall release the reservation when authorisation fails or the order is cancelled.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service, line.

requirements.title: Chargeback Dispute Handling
requirements.description: The Chargeback Service shall submit dispute evidence before the scheme deadline and shall post each chargeback outcome to the ledger exactly once.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service, line.

requirements.title: Card Payment Authorization
requirements.description: The Payment Service shall authorise card payments against the acquirer, capture an authorisation code and persist the transaction with its currency, amount and merchant reference.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service.

requirements.title: Currency Conversion Rate Sourcing
requirements.description: The Currency Service shall refresh FX rates every 15 minutes from the treasury feed, cache them and expose the rate age with every conversion.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service.

requirements.title: Full and Partial Refund Processing
requirements.description: The Refund Service shall support full and partial refunds against a captured payment, never exceeding the remaining refundable amount.
requirements.reason: Literal match on change keywords: service.

sections.title: Defect Analysis
sections.body: Two high-reoccurrence bugs directly affect this change: BUG-410 (VAT rounded at wrong level, breaking REQ-1030 and REQ-1011) is mitigated by TC-1160 and TC-1083, but TC-1160 is currently failing. BUG-214 (invoice sequence gaps after transaction rollback, breaking REQ-1015) is covered by TC-1111 and TC-1112. Additionally, BUG-221 (wrong currency symbol formatting in invoices) reached production before and is covered by TC-1111, TC-1116, and TC-1112. The team should prioritize fixing the TC-1160 failure, ensure all invoice sequence tests pass under load, and add the ISO-4217 catalogue assertion test flagged in CMT-1008 to prevent BUG-201 from recurring.

defects.title: Tax rounded per line instead of per invoice
defects.root_cause: Rounding applied at the wrong aggregation level.
defects.why_it_matters: This change touches Tax Calculation Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1030, REQ-1011, which this ECR also affects.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1160, TC-1083 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Invoice numbering gap after failed transaction
defects.root_cause: Sequence allocated inside the transaction that rolled back.
defects.why_it_matters: This change touches Invoice Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1015, which this ECR also affects.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1111, TC-1116, TC-1112 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Order total mismatch versus authorised amount
defects.root_cause: Total recalculated after the authorisation request was built.
defects.why_it_matters: This change indirectly affects Order Service, where the defect happened. It broke REQ-1011, REQ-1001, which this ECR also affects.
defects.what_to_check: Run TC-1083 to make sure it does not come back.

defects.title: Invoice amount formatted with wrong currency symbol

defects.why_it_matters: It broke REQ-1005, which this ECR also affects, but the change does not touch the code where it happened. It reached production last time.
defects.what_to_check: Low chance with this change. No extra check needed.

defects.what_to_check: Low chance with this change. No extra check needed.

defects.title: Partial refund exceeded remaining refundable amount

defects.title: Payment validation allowed invalid currency codes

defects.title: Rounding error on JPY payments

sections.title: Correlation Findings
sections.body:
Core VAT and invoicing changes have cross-source backing and test coverage for high-risk bugs BUG-410 and BUG-214. However, TC-1160 is failing (EV-5010), blocking validation of the primary requirement REQ-1030. Multiple affected requirements lack any test evidence, and BUG-201 needs specific ISO-4217 regression coverage not in the current test plan.
- Contradiction: Critical test TC-1160 for REQ-1030 (VAT rounding) is failing; blocks ECR validation.
- Gap: REQ-1011 order total with taxes only covered by TC-1083; no independent evidence.
- Gap: REQ-1013 (refund) and REQ-1026 (subscription renewal) lack direct test evidence linkage.
- Gap: Currency conversion bugs (BUG-101, BUG-155) with medium-to-high reoccurrence have no test coverage.
- Gap: ISO-4217 catalogue assertion regression test recommended by CMT-1008 not in test selection.
- Key link: VAT per-invoice rounding directly addresses REQ-1030 and BUG-410 recurrence risk via TC-1160.
- Key link: Invoice numbering sequence protection (TC-1111, TC-1112) mitigates high-risk BUG-214.
- Key link: CMT-1008 flags incomplete BUG-201 fix; ISO-4217 validation missing from REQ-1002 test coverage.
- Key link: Subscription renewal charging (REQ-1026) has dedicated test TC-1156 for currency handling.
